description.en: Agents, workspaces and settings are now in one sidebar on the left.
description.zh: 智能体、工作区与设置统一收纳在左侧边栏。

title.en: Fixes for OpenClaw and error messages

description.en: OpenClaw works alongside a Gateway already running on this computer, and agent errors state their actual cause.
description.zh: OpenClaw 可与本机已运行的 Gateway 共存，智能体报错会说明实际原因。

description.en: The interface style and accent colour options have been removed.
description.zh: 界面风格与强调色选项已移除。

description.en: The setup form fits on one screen, and optional endpoint fields are clearer.
description.zh: 添加表单无需滚动即可完成，接口地址的填写说明更清晰。
